hypotheses.reasoning: Traffic was clean until 21:27:29. Then the third-party geo-IP provider api.geoip.example began returning 502/503 to enrichment-svc (#110, #114, #118). enrichment-svc's circuit breaker opened at a 96% failure rate (#121). With the breaker open, enrichment-svc answered ingest-api with 503 (#138, #172), and the gateway passed those on as 503s on POST /v1/events (#122 and after). At 21:40 a half-open probe to the provider still got a 502 (#174), so the provider outage was still going on. No deploys, database or cache anomalies appear in the logs. The disk warning at 21:16 (#15) is unrelated.
Gateway latencies were long (15 to 29 seconds), which could be read as a timeout problem. But the errors themselves are explicit 5xx responses from the provider, not timeouts.

verdict.recommendedAction: Contact or escalate to the geo-IP provider and check their status page. Make enrichment degrade gracefully when the geo-IP lookup fails: skip geo enrichment or serve stale data from geo-cache, and accept events without geo data instead of returning 503 to ingest-api. Lower the timeouts between the gateway and ingest-api. Consider a backup geo-IP provider.
